# TinyCoder — Free Offline Developer Tools

## What This Is
A PWA with 5 developer tools that work offline:
- JSON Formatter & Validator
- Base64 Encoder/Decoder
- Regex Tester
- URL Encoder/Decoder
- UUID Generator

## Key Features
- 100% offline capability
- No tracking, no ads, no accounts
- Installable as native app
- White-label ready for agencies

## Pricing
- Free: Use all tools online or offline
- Paid Template: $29-79 for source code + white-label
